result.summary: This PR sets the QT_ASSUME_STDERR_HAS_CONSOLE=1 environment variable in the Windows CI scripts before running test_bitcoin-qt.exe. Without it, Qt's console-detection logic returns false in the GHA environment (no attached console), causing the entire unit test report to be silently discarded. The fix is a two-line addition across ci-windows.py and ci-windows-cross.py.
result.problem: CI maintainers currently cannot see the output of the Windows Qt unit test binary when it runs under GitHub Actions, because Qt suppresses stderr output when it thinks there's no console. This means test failures in that binary could go unnoticed, undermining trust in Windows CI results.
